eips.title: In-mempool signature and proof aggregation
eips.summary: Referenced as the mechanism that would allow users to optionally use Falcon signatures in the future.

moments.context: Emile noted that using EIP-8288 you can use Falcon if you want in the future, and Antonio confirmed.
Antonio reiterated that in the future EIP-8288 could be used, while the group remains committed to hash-based signatures for now.
